title: Answer card questions

request.details: GET with optional doc_id and include_answered. To answer on the user’s behalf, POST body and/or selected_option_ids to {{route:cards.question_answer}} before submitting the turn. Reading mode can answer with document-create permission.

response: Read item_id, seq, body, options, answered and the associated card. responder_error_code explains automatic-answer failure. Report whether card_resume shows resumes_after_chat_run, other pending questions or run_not_resumable.
errors: On 409 question_already_answered inspect the stored answer. Clarify which question is intended if ambiguous.
